rules.title: Exact local gate catalog
rules.description: Replace short gate blocks with cheaper blocks with the same signed permutation.
guards: Match an unconditioned unitary window on at most four existing wires.
Keep measurement and condition-stack changes as barriers.
Keep the inherited identity tail unchanged.

mechanism.match: A local unitary block whose signed permutation occurs in the exact catalog.
mechanism.replace: A cheaper block on the same wires and under the same unchanged outer condition.

rules.cost: Measure actual executed Toffolis and qubits after full-circuit validation.
rules.notes: The frontier runner integrates the catalog into pinned source. The staged policy runner does not execute this rule.
